route: /PXLBLZ-IDE/studio/shows/b97d1fa4-c054-4b07-8cb4-dde68f8a5e30 (v2 clone of stock-show-showcase-luma-sources, existing Show editor on the v2 backing)
operation: On the v2 backing, clone the built-in Luma Sources showcase. Select Clip luma-clip-1 (instance luma-Stripes: target sliderWidth 0.4 with lane track-luma-1-0) and untick 'Set Width target' in the Clip detail's Pattern tab: 'Remove Width control?' / 'The Width animation will be removed.' with Cancel and 'Remove Width' (capture 1). Cancel leaves the stored target and lane unchanged. Untick again and press 'Remove Width': sliderWidth and track-luma-1-0 are gone (capture 2). Close the panel, select luma-clip-2 (instance luma-SineWaves: sliderFeather has no lane) and untick 'Set Feather target': no dialog; sliderFeather is removed, sliderLean and its lane stay (capture 3). Capture 4 reads the stored v2 row back at each step; capture 5 is the raw GET /api/shows?show-version=2 response. Before this change the v2 untick refused silently and snapped back.
